subject: IPEA
title: Roles in Interprofessional Teams
description: A half day workshop, including preparatory work, that introduces interprofessional education, interprofessional practice, and the roles of the different healthcare professionals that make up an interprofessional team.

subject: IPEA
title: Communication in Interprofessional Teams
description: A half day workshop, including preparatory work, introducing effective communication and interactions in interprofessional teams.

subject: IPEA
title: Partnership in Interprofessional Teams
description: Introduction to the principles of interprofessional collaboration through case-based learning experience. Observation and analysis of simulated interprofessional interactions involving a person receiving care and their care partners. Team dynamics, communication strategies, and collaborative decision-making processes to identify best practices and challenges in interprofessional teamwork, emphasizing reflection on professional roles, mutual respect, and person-centered care in complex clinical contexts.

prerequisites.text: IPEA 500 and IPEA 501 or permission of the instructor.

corequisites.text: IPEA 503 or permission of the instructor

subject: IPEA
title: Navigating Disagreement in Interprofessional Teams
description: Introduction to navigating team differences and disagreements in interprofessional health care settings through case-based learning experiences. Psychological safety, mutual respect, and shared decision-making contributing to effective team functioning. Proactive approaches to address sources of disagreement, prevent escalation, foster cooperative dialogue, and leverage conflict to strengthen team cohesion, support problem-solving, and enhance collaboration.

prerequisites.text: IPEA 500 and IPEA 501 or permission of the instructor.

corequisites.text: IPEA 502 or permission of the instructor.
